title: Coursera
description: Coursera partners with top universities and companies to offer online courses, specializations, and degrees. Features include video lectures, peer-reviewed assignments, certificates, and full degree programs. Courses from Stanford, Yale, Google, IBM, and more. Free audit option available, paid certificates, and subscription plans. Covers technology, business, data science, arts, and more. Perfect for professional development and academic learning.

title: Khan Academy
description: Khan Academy is a free online learning platform offering courses and tutorials in various subjects, with a focus on education and career development.

title: Codecademy
description: Codecademy is an interactive online learning platform for coding and programming. Features hands-on coding exercises, real-time feedback, projects, and career paths. Covers web development, data science, computer science, and more. Free tier with basic courses, Pro subscription for advanced content and certificates. Great for beginners with its interactive approach. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL, and many other languages.

title: Yoodli AI
description: Yoodli AI is an AI-powered speech coaching platform that provides real-time feedback during video calls and interviews. Analyzes speech patterns, pace, filler words, and provides suggestions for improvement. Features include private practice sessions, interview simulation, confidence building, and detailed analytics. Free tier available. Perfect for job seekers, public speakers, and professionals looking to improve communication skills. Works with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

title: Skillshare

title: MasterClass
description: MasterClass is a premium online learning platform featuring video courses taught by world-renowned experts and celebrities. Learn from industry leaders like Gordon Ramsay (cooking), Neil deGrasse Tyson (science), Serena Williams (tennis), and Timbaland (music production). Features include high-quality video production, downloadable workbooks, community discussions, and mobile apps. Subscription-based model with annual or monthly plans. Perfect for creative skills, business, writing, and personal development.
